summary: At Parallel Domain, we believe that autonomous systems – from self-driving cars to contactless delivery drones – have the opportunity to drastically improve the quality of life for billions of…
description:
At Parallel Domain, we believe that autonomous systems – from self-driving cars to contactless delivery drones – have the opportunity to drastically improve the quality of life for billions of people. That is why we love what we do: enabling our customers to develop their technology safely using the Parallel Domain data generation platform. Our platform revolutionizes the way our customers generate sensor data for AI development. We're looking for people like you to join us in pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence and synthetic data.

About the role 

Before any physical AI system is trusted in the real world, it has to prove itself in ours. Parallel Domain turns real captured drives into faithful digital replicas — geometry, appearance and motion that perception stacks are trained and validated against.

We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to push our feed-forward reconstruction stack forward — from static 3D toward full 4D scenes over time. You will join a small, deep team where your technical judgment carries real weight from day one, and your work will ship in a pipeline customers depend on.

What You'll Do

Advance our feed-forward reconstruction models. Improve how we predict geometry, camera pose and appearance from real capture with transformer-based models, and extend it from static scenes to dynamic 4D.

About Us
We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity.
Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next.
The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve.
Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost.

🚲Derrière chaque piste cyclable pérennisée, chaque site naturel préservé, il y a une décision. Et derrière cette décision, il y a nos données.

Chez Eco-Compteur, nous aidons les villes et les gestionnaires d’espaces naturels à décider sur des faits, pas à l’intuition. 
Nos capteurs connectés mesurent la fréquentation piétons et cyclistes, en ville comme en pleine nature, et nos logiciels transforment ces données en indicateurs concrets : impact d’un aménagement, évolution de la pratique, effet des saisons. Parce que compter, c’est bien, mais donner du sens aux chiffres, c’est encore mieux !
🌍 Pionniers et leader mondial d’un métier que nous avons créé il y a plus de 20 ans, nous sommes basés en Bretagne, avec des filiales sur quatre continents et des solutions présentes dans plus de 55 pays.
🤝 Une entreprise à taille humaine, portée par l’autonomie, la responsabilité et la transparence, avec beaucoup de passion (et de plaisir !).
Envie que vos compétences aient un impact concret ? Nous recherchons notre prochain·e :

Stage de fin d’études · 6 mois · Lannion (22)
Nous préparons un nouveau banc de test capable de piloter une dizaine de produits différents. Chaque produit sera relié à une carte de pilotage qui gère ses interfaces, son alimentation et la mesure de sa consommation. Un poste central dialogue ensuite avec chacune de ces cartes pour dérouler les tests et scénarios attendus.

Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital is looking for a Software Engineer to join the Dynamics team within Ground Platform. Dynamics computes the timeline of what every spacecraft in our fleet can do and when (contacts with ground stations, links, accesses, unavailability windows) and turns it into schedules: which satellite talks to which ground station, when, and in which order of priority.

You’ll bring strong backend engineering to that challenge: making our APIs fast, our databases scale, and our contact allocation and scheduling smarter. description:
sizeless builds the data layer for physical AI in construction. Contractors film an open trench with a smartphone. Our system turns that video into a 3D model, recognises what is in the ground, and delivers the documentation the industry needs – CAD, BIM, GIS and quantities. The same data is the foundation for training the robots that will one day work on construction sites.
It is a real problem with real customers: construction and utilities still document reality by hand, and almost nothing about that process has changed in decades. We are a small team with research experience from ETH Zurich, UC Berkeley and MIT, and we are looking for an engineer who wants to bring this technology onto real construction sites and make it work for our customers.
Tasks
Work directly with our customers – contractors, utilities and surveyors in Switzerland, Germany and Austria – from first site visit to daily use

Get field crews up and running with our capture app, on site and remotely

Adapt our outputs to each customer's CAD, GIS and documentation standards

Write the scripts, integrations and tooling that connect sizeless to customer systems

Bring what you learn on site back into the product, together with the engineering team

description:
About EASE
EASE builds active, AI-powered exoskeletons for logistics and manufacturing. As a TUM spin-off, we have just started series production, and paid pilots with well-known logistics companies have led to first purchase orders. Our goal: move every parcel better, manually with an exoskeleton or autonomously with a robot.
The role
Our exoskeletons are deployed in real warehouses and production plants and capture what video-only datasets miss: body pose, joint kinematics, interaction torques, vision, and hand forces from real human work. Your job is to turn that data into skills our humanoid can actually perform, so that human workers and robots can work side by side on the same tasks.
What you'll do
Map human motion onto humanoid kinematics and close the embodiment gap

Train manipulation and whole-body policies with imitation and reinforcement learning

Evaluate in Isaac Lab or MuJoCo and on our in-house humanoid, and measure the value of our data

Define what data training needs and help build our training setup, including GPU compute

Turn new research on robot foundation models and VLAs into prototypes

What you bring
Master's or PhD in robotics, CS, ML or similar, with hands-on experience from industry or research

Imitation or reinforcement learning on real robots (e.g. Diffusion Policy, ACT, PPO)

Strong Python and PyTorch; C++ is a plus

Physics simulation and sim-to-real transfer

Solid kinematics, dynamics and control

summary: Who we are Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language,…
description:
Who we are
Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.
We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.
We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.
In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

About the role
You’ll join our research team for a 4 to 6 month internship, in the cohort that starts in May 2027. The work is hands-on, with tabular foundation models, a new class of AI model, and how they’re applied. We have more open research problems than people to work on them, and you’ll get a project matched to your interests and expertise, with the chance to publish the results. Some of the problems…

about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to interact with their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

description:
About Tritium Fuel Cycle (TFC)GFG is designing a first-of-a-kind (FOAK) fusion power plant (FPP) to deliver 1 GW of electrical power in the 2040s. The “GIGA” plant will be based on a stellarator magnetic confinement fusion device, operating continuously on a deuterium-tritium (D-T) fuel cycle.  Prior to this, the smaller “Gauss Industrial Demonstrator (GID-170)” will be deployed in the mid-2030s.

While deuterium can be extracted from seawater, tritium is a tightly controlled radioactive isotope with an extremely limited global supply. Therefore, both GID-170 and GIGA must utilise closed tritium fuel cycle infrastructure, to ensure that unburnt tritium is fully recycled back to the stellarator and not released to the environment. Meanwhile, the tritium consumed by the fusion reaction must be replenished using tritium breeding blankets (TBB).

A first-of-a-kind dedicated tritium fuel cycle (TFC) facility, suitable for continuously supporting a stellarator device, must be designed, built and commissioned. It will adopt a multi-loop process architecture, each loop comprising many deeply integrated subsystems. Developing such a facility presents unique engineering challenges: the supply chain is still emerging, commercial process simulation tools lack dedicated TFC libraries, suitable off-the-shelf equipment is not always available, and some technologies have relatively low technology readiness levels (TRLs).

description:
quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app.

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.

Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll.

The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. 

Where this is going

Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either.

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

Publitas lets people, and increasingly agents, create, host and distribute digital flyers and catalogues for retail brands. Our customers include ALDI, IKEA, Carrefour, Metro and Decathlon. About Clarity Pediatrics

Clarity Pediatrics is reimagining pediatric chronic care, starting with ADHD. After successfully launching our virtual clinic for ADHD and anxiety, we are expanding our pediatric care platform to address other common chronic conditions and are focused right now on Obesity and Overweight management. Our clinical model is tech-enabled, backed by the best science, and designed to deliver exceptional health outcomes that transform a child's trajectory.
Our co-founders and leadership team have deep commitment to clinical excellence and domain expertise in healthcare. Our CEO, Christina LaMontagne, has led two startups and earned her MBA at Harvard Business School. Our Chief Medical Officer,Alesandro Larrazabal, MD, trained at UCSF and Stanford. Until recently, he was a Medical Director building specialty care services at Kaiser Permanente. Earlier, he worked at IDEO.
We're backed by top VCs who have supported category-defining health-tech companies like One Medical, Hims, Spring Health, Cityblock, Honor, and Tia.
The Role
For a lot of families, food is where the hardest moments of the day happen. ADHD medications can blunt appetite, picky eating can turn dinner into a standoff, and weight conversations can leave kids feeling judged. As our Registered Dietitian, you'll help families turn those moments into progress, with care that is practical, evidence-based, and free of stigma.

Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Abuse Operations is the front-line incident response and remediation function handling active product abuse and fraud impacting Stripe and its merchants. This multi-disciplinary group, spanning Incident Managers, Investigators, Forward Deployed Security Engineers, and Data Scientists, neutralizes active attacks, gathers requirements for operational tooling, and leads incidents. The team  works directly with impacted merchants to resolve technical incidents and policy abuse rapidly. Operating primarily across Eastern, Pacific and Western European time zones, these team members regularly coordinate with global stakeholders across the world.

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge —you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge—you will often be "the PM."

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

About Stripe and Bridge

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Bridge is a subsidiary of Stripe that is building a new payments platform powered by stablecoins to make global money movement simpler, faster, and more accessible. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders, give customers access to dollars through virtual accounts, and disburse USD globally.

About the team

We are seeking a Senior Treasury Specialist to oversee capital adequacy, liquidity stress testing, financial risk management, and contingency funding planning for Bridge National Trust Bank (BNTB)'s Treasury and Reserve Operations.
